scope: Actual exported appliance: every installed wiring body against selected above-core equipment, fixed front interfaces and termination bodies, all six enclosure pieces, two top core caps, funnel frame and electronics roof panel. Current source-defined nominal retaining strips are separate supplemental targets. Both B-fill fittings are tested against every wiring body. The external compressor jacket also clears the physical foam shell. No wire-to-wire packing, physical fit, electrical or energization qualification.
candidate_method: Native bounding boxes and route capsules inflated 1 mm against the bound viewer payload, plus native containment witnesses; native Booleans for candidates.
endpoint_rule: Only named device attachments and a conductor's own termination IDs receive local endpoint neighborhoods, matching installed/review.py. A termination receives those same local neighborhoods at its own named mating device. The two named empty physical J4.IO23/IO27 cells use the same8.5 mm own-device neighborhoods only after exact residual containment. Native fuse-stub contact uses the existing 2.5 mm neighborhood.

preparation_lengths.scope: Developed lengths from this actual exported manifest compared with current preparation stock. The compressor hot allocation includes both AC4-H and AC4-fuse pieces; the reservoir-A common includes all three continuing earth spans. Remaining stock is a nominal cutting allowance, not physical dressing or termination qualification.

empty_housing_mating_proof.scope: Two physical empty housing cells; no electrical graph terminals or whole-device exclusion added.
